8: /// <summary>

13: ///   the pinned <c>invocation.txt</c> the seat runs; it reads only the packet
14: ///   files and never executes a process.</item>

16: ///   with <c>--write</c>, stores a create-new record plus a raw copy.</item>
17: /// <item><c>status</c> reports resolution, declaration, records, and the gate
18: ///   decision the approved transition applies.</item>

549:     internal static string RenderPrompt(
550:         string runtime,
551:         string repoRoot,
552:         string repo,
553:         int pr,
554:         string head,
555:         string unit,
556:         string clone,
557:         byte[] bodyBytes,
558:         byte[] reviewContextBytes,
559:         byte[] implementationBytes)
560:     {
561:         var q = CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.ShellQuote;
562:         var prText = pr.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
563:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
564:         builder.Append($"# Implementation review: {repo} PR #{prText} ({unit})\n\n");
565:         builder.Append("You are an independent reviewer on a different runtime from the author. ");
566:         builder.Append($"Review pull request #{prText} in {repo} at head {head}.\n\n");
567:         builder.Append("## Inputs\n\n");
568:         if (runtime is CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Copilot or CrossRuntimeReviewRuntimes.Opencode)
569:         {
570:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "github-body.md", bodyBytes);
571:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "review-context.md", reviewContextBytes);
572:             AppendEmbeddedFile(builder, "implementation.md", implementationBytes);
573:         }
574:         else
575:         {
576:             var packetDirectory = CrossRuntimeReviewPaths.PacketDirectory(repoRoot, unit);
577:             builder.Append($"- Issue contract (packet github-body.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "github-body.md"))}\n");
578:             builder.Append($"- Review context (packet review-context.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "review-context.md"))}\n");
579:             builder.Append($"- Implementation notes (packet implementation.md): {q(Path.Combine(packetDirectory, "implementation.md"))}\n");

638:     private static void AppendEmbeddedFile(StringBuilder builder, string fileName, byte[] bytes)
639:     {
640:         var content = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true).GetString(bytes);
641:         // A fence longer than any backtick run in the file keeps the embedded
642:         // bytes verbatim and the boundary unambiguous (CommonMark).
643:         var fence = new string('`', Math.Max(3, LongestBacktickRun(content) + 1));
644:         builder.Append($"### {fileName}\n\n");
645:         builder.Append(fence);
646:         builder.Append(fileName);
647:         builder.Append('\n');
648:         builder.Append(content);
649:         if (bytes.Length == 0 || bytes[^1] != (byte)'\n')
650:         {
651:             builder.Append('\n');
652:         }
653: 
654:         builder.Append(fence);
655:         builder.Append("\n\n");
656:     }

658:     internal static int LongestBacktickRun(string content)
659:     {
660:         var longest = 0;
661:         var current = 0;
662:         foreach (var character in content)
663:         {
664:             current = character == '`' ? current + 1 : 0;
665:             longest = Math.Max(longest, current);
666:         }
667: 
668:         return longest;
669:     }

1565:     private static bool TryParse(
1566:         string[] args,
1567:         FlagSet flags,
1568:         TextWriter writer,
1569:         string usage,
1570:         out Dictionary<string, string> options,
1571:         out string format)
1572:     {
1573:         options = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
1574:         format = FormatMarkdown;
1575:         for (var index = 0; index < args.Length; index++)
1576:         {
1577:             var argument = args[index];
1578:             if (flags.SwitchFlags.Contains(argument, StringComparer.Ordinal))
1579:             {
1580:                 if (argument == "--dry-run")
1581:                 {
1582:                     options.Remove("--write");
1583:                 }
1584:                 else
1585:                 {
1586:                     options[argument] = "true";
1587:                 }
1588: 
1589:                 continue;
1590:             }
1591: 
1592:             if (!flags.ValueFlags.Contains(argument, StringComparer.Ordinal))
1593:             {
1594:                 writer.WriteLine($"Unknown argument '{argument}'.");
1595:                 writer.WriteLine(usage);
1596:                 return false;
1597:             }
1598: 
1599:             if (index + 1 >= args.Length)
1600:             {
1601:                 writer.WriteLine($"{argument} requires a value.");
1602:                 writer.WriteLine(usage);
1603:                 return false;
1604:             }
1605: 
1606:             var value = args[++index];
1607:             if (argument != "--model" && string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
1608:             {
1609:                 writer.WriteLine($"{argument} requires a value.");
1610:                 writer.WriteLine(usage);
1611:                 return false;
1612:             }
1613: 
1614:             options[argument] = value;
1615:         }
1616: 
1617:         if (options.TryGetValue("--format", out var requested))
1618:         {
1619:             if (requested is not FormatJson and not FormatMarkdown)
1620:             {
1621:                 writer.WriteLine("--format must be json or markdown.");
1622:                 writer.WriteLine(usage);
1623:                 return false;
1624:             }
1625: 
1626:             format = requested;
1627:         }
1628: 
1629:         return true;
1630:     }

10:     {

13:         var inToken = false;
14:         for (var index = 0; index < command.Length; index++)
15:         {
16:             var character = command[index];
17:             if (character == '\'')
18:             {
19:                 inToken = true;
20:                 var end = command.IndexOf('\'', index + 1);
21:                 current.Append(command, index + 1, end - index - 1);
22:                 index = end;
23:             }
24:             else if (character == '"')
25:             {
26:                 inToken = true;

28:                 current.Append(command, index + 1, end - index - 1);
29:                 index = end;
30:             }

32:             {
33:                 inToken = true;
34:                 current.Append(command[++index]);
35:             }
36:             else if (char.IsWhiteSpace(character))
37:             {
38:                 if (inToken)

40:                     tokens.Add(current.ToString());
41:                     current.Clear();
42:                     inToken = false;
43:                 }
44:             }

`issue publish-flow --write` creates the GitHub issue. Records are bound to the

  `implementation.md`. The canonical publish path refuses until that evidence is

```text
intent-cli review cross-runtime request --kind design --execution-unit <unit> --runtime codex|claude|cursor --out-dir <dir> [--clone <read-only-clone>] [--model <name>]
intent-cli review cross-runtime record --kind design --execution-unit <unit> --packet-digest <sha256> --runtime <runtime> --runtime-version <text> --verdict-file <file> [--model <name>] [--write]

```

Design records live under `.intent-cli/cross-runtime-reviews/design/<unit>/`.
The design gate shares G834's approval rules with head replaced by digest, plus an
epoch rule when a packet returns to an earlier digest. `issue publish-flow` on a

refuses `domain-mismatch` and `target-repo-mismatch` on the create path, and adds

issue, declared teams receive `idempotent-not-gated`.

**Forward compatibility.** An intent-cli without G835 ignores design records and
applies no publish-flow gate. Refresh every intent-cli that publishes packets for a
declared team before relying on the design gate.

## Copilot CLI and OpenCode runtimes (G842 — preview-through-1.x)

G842 adds `copilot` (GitHub Copilot CLI) and `opencode` (OpenCode) to the
cross-runtime set beside `codex`, `claude`, and `cursor`. Any of the five may be
the declared `conductor_runtime`, a reviewer (`review cross-runtime request` /
`record` / `status` for both `--kind implementation` and `--kind design`), or a
builder (`guide solo-conductor` builder invocations). intent-cli renders text and
records evidence only; it never launches a reviewer, a builder, or an AI
provider CLI. The one exception remains the pre-existing claim-read `git fetch`.

289: ```

291: `request` creates empty isolation directories under `--out-dir` (`copilot-home`,
292: `copilot-xdg`, `opencode-xdg`, `opencode-config-dir`) and, for opencode, writes
293: `opencode-reviewer.json`. intent-cli never reads the operator's Copilot home or
294: OpenCode config directories; it reads only an optional `--opencode-provider-config`
295: file when given.

298: 
299: - **copilot:** `--available-tools view rg glob` leaves only those three tools, so
300:   the reviewer reads files but cannot write or run commands. Path verification
301:   refuses reads outside the workspace. `--disable-builtin-mcps` disables the
302:   GitHub MCP server. With the isolated home, the operator's user MCP servers do
303:   not start (measured). `COPILOT_ALLOW_ALL=` stops the environment variable from
304:   trusting the workspace. `COPILOT_HOME` and `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` point at empty
305:   directories that intent-cli created under the out-dir, so the operator's
306:   `trustedFolders`, IDE lock files, user hooks, and user MCP servers are not read.
307: - **opencode:** The rendered config denies every tool (`*`) and allows only read,
308:   glob, grep, and list, at the top level and for the `intent-cli-reviewer` agent.
309:   `task` is denied because agent-level denials do not reach subagents.
310:   `external_directory` is denied, so reads outside the workspace are refused.
311:   `OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1` and `--pure` stop the reviewed workspace's
312:   `opencode.json`, `.opencode` agents, plugins, and MCP entries from overriding
313:   these rules or running code. `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` point
314:   at empty directories that intent-cli created, and the two empty variables clear
315:   any inherited inline config or permissions.
316: 
317: **Trusted-folder warning.** Keep isolated clones outside every runtime's trusted
318: folders. The copilot builder line uses a fresh, empty `COPILOT_HOME` and
319: `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` per run so the operator's Copilot trust settings, hooks, and
320: MCP servers never apply to it.
321: 
322: ### Relation rule
323: 
324: `relation` is `same-runtime` exactly when the reviewer's `--runtime` equals the
325: declared `conductor_runtime` (ordinal), and `cross-runtime` otherwise. The rule is
326: by CLI runtime, not by model vendor or provider:
327: 
328: | conductor ↓ / reviewer → | codex | claude | cursor | copilot | opencode |
329: |---|---|---|---|---|---|
330: | codex | same | cross | cross | cross | cross |
331: | claude | cross | same | cross | cross | cross |
332: | cursor | cross | cross | same | cross | cross |
333: | copilot | cross | cross | cross | same | cross |
334: | opencode | cross | cross | cross | cross | same |
335: 
336: Advise a reviewer model from a different vendor and model family than the
337: conductor's model; the gate does not check this.
338: 
339: ### `--model`, `--effort`, and provider config
340: 
341: - **`--model` is required for `copilot` and `opencode`** on `request` and
342:   `record` for both kinds. A missing value refuses
343:   `cross-runtime-review-model-required`. `--model` stays optional for the other
344:   three. copilot `auto` (any case) refuses `cross-runtime-review-model-invalid`.
345:   opencode values must be `provider/model` with a valid provider id.
346: - **Optional `--effort`.** copilot accepts exactly
347:   `none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max` (rendered as `--reasoning-effort`).
348:   opencode accepts any non-empty value passing character rules (rendered as
349:   `--variant`). codex, claude, and cursor refuse `--effort` as
350:   `cross-runtime-review-argument-invalid`.
351: - **`--opencode-provider-config <file>`** (`request` only, `opencode` only,
352:   optional). The file is UTF-8 JSON whose root has exactly one key, `provider`,
353:   with an object value. The rendered `opencode-reviewer.json` inserts that
354:   `provider` block after `$schema`. The request result names the file as
355:   `opencode_provider_config` when given.
356:

361: 
362: ### Verdict envelopes
363: 
364: Both new runtimes use UTF-8 JSONL. A bare verdict object (no runtime `type` field)
365: is refused. The verdict object is taken from the final answer text by
366: `TryParseTrailingObject` (narration before the object is accepted; nothing after
367: it; a fenced verdict is refused).
368: 
369: - **copilot:** The last event must be the only `type: "result"` with `exitCode` 0.
370:   Exactly one `type: "assistant.message"` has `data.phase == "final_answer"` with
371:   string `data.content` and absent or empty `data.toolRequests`. Observed model
372:   must match `--model`; when `--effort` is given, observed effort must match.
373: - **opencode:** Events follow a pinned state machine; terminal `step_finish` with
374:   `part.reason == "stop"` ends the answer step. An `error` event refuses with
375:   `error.name` and `error.data.message`. Events after termination are refused.
376:

379: `guide solo-conductor` adds a `builder` field and a **Builder invocations
380: (guidance)** Markdown section. Step 6 points to it. The field holds a seven-item
381: `contract`, five `invocations` (codex, claude, cursor, copilot, opencode) with
382: `runtime`, `command`, `enforcement`, and `measured`, and `opencode_config` (the
383: pinned builder config text). `--model` is required for the copilot and opencode
384: builder lines; their `enforcement` texts begin with `The model is required.`
385: The OpenCode builder runs with fresh, empty `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and
386: `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR` per run; the task file carries every repository instruction
387: the builder needs because project config and `AGENTS.md` are not loaded.
388: 
389: **Local-model rule.** A local model provider serves one seat at a time. Do not
390: start a local-model builder or reviewer while another local-model seat runs;
391: intent-cli does not check this.
392: 
393: **Forward compatibility.** An intent-cli without G842 refuses
394: `cross-runtime-review-runtime-invalid` for the two new runtimes and cannot read
395: a stored record with `runtime: copilot` or `runtime: opencode` (`record-unreadable`,
396: gate fails closed). Refresh every binary that reads the host before recording
397: with copilot or opencode.

400: 
401: G695 makes the completion-to-next-action boundary observable without changing

1: namespace IntentSystem.Cli.Commands;
2: 
3: /// <summary>
4: /// G834: path, repository, and shell-quoting rules shared by the cross-runtime
5: /// review request, record store, and gate.
6: /// </summary>
7: internal static class CrossRuntimeReviewPaths
8: {
9:     public const string StoreRootRelativePath = ".intent-cli/cross-runtime-reviews";
10:     public const string PacketRootRelativePath = ".intent-cli/issues";
11: 
12:     /// <summary>
13:     /// <c><owner>/<repo></c> with ASCII letters, digits, <c>-</c>, <c>_</c>,
14:     /// and <c>.</c> in each segment, never a dot-segment. The same rule guards the
15:     /// store folder, so a repository name can never escape the store root.
16:     /// </summary>
17:     public static bool IsRepositoryName(string? value)
18:     {
19:         if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
20:         {
21:             return false;
22:         }
23: 
24:         var segments = value.Split('/');
25:         return segments.Length == 2

105:     /// embedded <c>'</c> becomes <c>'\''</c>. Spaces, <c>$</c>, <c>;</c>, and
106:     /// backticks are inert inside single quotes. Newline and NUL are refused
